concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of *pre‑processed* PPMI ASV tables, but T001 only validates raw user‑provided files and does not ensure they meet the ‘pre‑processed’ condition, effectively weakening FR-001.

User Story 1 explicitly demands taxa‑progression correlations *after controlling for age, sex, and medication*, yet T004 computes an unadjusted Spearman correlation (FR‑004) with no covariate adjustment, violating the story’s acceptance criteria.

FR‑009 mandates that all reported associations be framed as *associational* with no causal language. T010’s verification only checks that the methods paragraph “contains no causal‑language keywords” but provides no concrete test (e.g., keyword search) to enforce this, leaving the requirement unverified.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires a title‑token‑overlap check for citations. T013’s description of dataset citation verification does not mention performing this overlap validation, thus it omits a mandatory constitution check.
